invariants.text: Contact.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
When a new contact is created, the created_at field must be set to the current timestamp.
When a contact is updated, the updated_at field must be set to the current timestamp.
The email field of a contact must be unique across all contacts.
The phone field of a contact must be unique across all contacts.

If a contact import operation encounters a row with invalid data (e.g., missing required fields or malformed email/phone), that row must be rejected and no changes should be made to the existing contact data.
All exported contacts must include the fields: first_name, last_name, email, phone, address, created_at, and updated_at.
When a contact is deleted, its record must be removed from the database, and no other contact fields should be affected.
A contact must have a first_name and last_name field, and both must be non-empty strings.
The address field of a contact may be empty or null, but must not contain invalid characters or formatting that would prevent parsing.
The created_at field must not be later than the updated_at field for any contact.
